daas-irab:72-72.t: The i'rab of a similar ayah has already been given in the preceding ayah.

daas-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وَمِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb after them. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «الليل». ﴿لِتَسْكُنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb «جعل». ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَلِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ conjoined to «لتسكنوا». ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and «لعل» with its noun. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل», and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:74-74.t: Its i'rab has already been given at ayah no. 62.

daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿وَنَزَعْنا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb with its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَهِيداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the fāʾ is a conjunction: ﴿فَقُلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هاتُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بُرْهانَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَعَلِمُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb with its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ its noun. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and both are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن», its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of «علموا». ﴿وَضَلَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا», and the clause «كانوا..» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿قارُونَ﴾ its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان». ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar of «إن», and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَبَغى﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الْكُنُوزِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿مَفاتِحَهُ﴾ its noun. ﴿لَتَنُوأُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿تنوء﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar of «إن», and the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما». ﴿بِالْعُصْبَةِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿أُولِي﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «العصبة». ﴿الْقُوَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿قَوْمُهُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لا تَفْرَحْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْفَرِحِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of «إن», and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿وَابْتَغِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِيما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is conjoined to the clause «لا تفرح». ﴿آتاكَ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما». ﴿الدَّارَ﴾ the object of «ابتغ». ﴿الْآخِرَةَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «الدار». ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and «لا» is prohibitive. ﴿تَنْسَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿نَصِيبَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الدُّنْيا﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَحْسِنْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a particle of comparison and of the genitive, and «ما» is maṣdarī (infinitival). ﴿أَحْسِنْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa «[Translator's note: the word here is «أَحْسَنَ» in the Quranic text; the source prints it with the vowelling of the imperative.]». ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «ما» and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and «لا» is prohibitive. ﴿تَبْغِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive «لا», and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْفَسادَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:78-78.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [«ما»] and the restrained [«إن»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أُوتِيتُهُ﴾ a passive past verb; the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى عِلْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation, the wāw is a resumptive particle, and «لم» is a jussive particle. ﴿يَعْلَمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, the noun of «أن». ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَهْلَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ also attached to the verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن», its noun and its khabar stands in place of the object of «يعلم». ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «مَنْ»; the source prints it as «مِنْ».]». ﴿هُوَ أَشَدُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من». ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ attached to «أشد». ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَكْثَرُ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «أشد». ﴿جَمْعاً﴾ tamyīz. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and «لا» is negative. ﴿يُسْئَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿عَنْ ذُنُوبِهِمُ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿فَخَرَجَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فِي زِينَتِهِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined to the clause «قال إنما». ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة»; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿لَيْتَ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of «ليت». ﴿مِثْلَ﴾ its delayed noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿قارُونُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila of «ما». ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿لَذُو﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿ذو﴾ the khabar of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿حَظٍّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ naʿt of «حظ»; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيْلَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿ثَوابُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «خير»; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila of «من». ﴿عَمِلَ﴾ ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾ conjoined to «آمن». ﴿صالِحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and «لا» is negative. ﴿يُلَقَّاها﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and «ها» is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الصَّابِرُونَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:81-81.t: ﴿فَخَسَفْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb with its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿وَبِدارِهِ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and «ما» is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان». ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿فِئَةٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position: the delayed noun of «كان». ﴿يَنْصُرُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «فئة». ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنَ المُنْتَصِرِينَ﴾ the khabar of «كان»; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿وَأَصْبَحَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the noun of «أصبح». ﴿تَمَنَّوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مَكانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْأَمْسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أصبح», and the clause «أصبح..» is conjoined to the clause «خسفنا». ﴿وي﴾ a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) of the imperfect, meaning "I marvel". ﴿كأن﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, its noun. ﴿يَبْسُطُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of «كأن». ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila of «من». ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ conjoined to «يبسط». ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an infinitival and subjunctive particle. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «مَنَّ»; the source prints it as «مِنْ».]». ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil «[Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; as fāʿil it is «اللَّهُ».]». ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar is omitted. ﴿لَخَسَفَ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِنا﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position. ﴿وي﴾ a verbal noun of the imperfect, meaning "I marvel". ﴿كأنه﴾ «كأن» and its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُفْلِحُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «كأن».

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الدَّارُ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿الْآخِرَةُ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «الدار». ﴿نَجْعَلُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «تلك», and the clause «تلك..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. ﴿عُلُوًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to «علوا». ﴿وَلا﴾ and the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿فَساداً﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «علوا». ﴿وَالْعاقِبَةُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَلَهُ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْها﴾ attached to «خير»; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من», and the clause «من..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِالسَّيِّئَةِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is connective and «لا» is negative. ﴿يُجْزَى﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من», and the clause «من..» is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا», and the clause «كانوا..» is the ṣila of «ما», with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:85-85.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the noun of «إن». ﴿فَرَضَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position. ﴿لَرادُّكَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the nominal clause «إن الذي..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى مَعادٍ﴾ attached to «رادك». ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi of «أعلم». ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of «من», with no grammatical position. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and «من» is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «ضلال»; the nominal clause is the ṣila of «من», with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:86-86.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and «ما» is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَرْجُوا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يُلْقى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن». ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْكِتابُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and what follows it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «ترجو». ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة». ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa [fāʾ, implying an unstated condition], and «لا» is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُونَنَّ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive «لا»; the nūn is for emphasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun. ﴿ظَهِيراً﴾ the khabar of «تكونن». ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ attached to «ظهيرا»; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:87-87.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and «لا» is prohibitive. ﴿يَصُدُّنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and the wāw of the plural, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَنْ آياتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أُنْزِلَتْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. And ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَ﴾ and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ادْعُ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَكُونَنَّ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive «لا»; the nūn is for emphasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of «تكونن»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:88-88.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَدْعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلهاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آخَرَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «إلها»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, which operates like «إن». ﴿إِلهَ﴾ the noun of «لا», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the implied (muqaddar) pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate) of «لا»; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كُلُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هالِكٌ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿وَجْهَهُ﴾ excepted by «إلا»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb after them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is conjoined to what precedes it by the wāw.

daas-irab:1-2.t: The i'rab of the two ayahs has preceded at the beginning of Surat al-Shuʿarāʾ.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿نَتْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ نَبَإِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَفِرْعَوْنَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to موسى. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: لقوم, a preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to the verb نتلو; and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿عَلا﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَهْلَها﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شِيَعاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَسْتَضْعِفُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿طائِفَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of طائفة. ﴿يُذَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَبْناءَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a badal (substitute) from the one before it. ﴿وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِساءَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كان; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. The nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿وَنُرِيدُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ نَمُنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اسْتُضْعِفُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَئِمَّةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوارِثِينَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَنُمَكِّنَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَنُرِيَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهامانَ﴾: conjoined to فرعون. ﴿وَجُنُودَهُما﴾: also conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb نري. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿يَحْذَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كانوا.. is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى أُمِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle of explication (tafsīr), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَرْضِعِيهِ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿خِفْتِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَأَلْقِيهِ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فِي الْيَمِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to إذا. ﴿وَلا تَخافِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, and the yāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تَحْزَنِي﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿رَادُّوهُ﴾: its khabar (predicate), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَيْكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رادوه; the clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجاعِلُوهُ﴾: conjoined to رادوه. ﴿مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاعلوه.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿فَالْتَقَطَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿آلُ﴾: fāʿil (agent), annexed to ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to something omitted and implied. ﴿لِيَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām, and its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them. ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of يكون. ﴿وَحَزَناً﴾: conjoined to عدوا; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implicit أن and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: إنّ and its noun, and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَهامانَ﴾: conjoined to فرعون. ﴿وَجُنُودَهُما﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كانُوا خاطِئِينَ﴾: كان, its noun and its khabar; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنّ.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَقالَتِ امْرَأَتُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. And ﴿قُرَّتُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَيْنٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of قرة. ﴿وَلَكَ﴾: [the preposition and its genitive noun are] conjoined to لي; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا تَقْتُلُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَسى﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنْ يَنْفَعَنا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the khabar of عسى. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نَتَّخِذَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَلَداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤادُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿أُمِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُوسى﴾: likewise muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فارِغاً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِنْ﴾: lightened from the heavy [إنّ], without governing effect. ﴿كادَتْ﴾: an incomplete past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَتُبْدِي﴾: the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the khabar of كادت. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: conditional, non-jussive. ﴿أَنْ رَبَطْنا﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى قَلْبِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. The answer of لولا is omitted because what precedes indicates it. ﴿لِتَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of تكون; the interpreted maṣdar from the implicit أن and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ربطنا.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وَقالَتْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِأُخْتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿قُصِّيهِ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the yāʾ is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَبَصُرَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَنْ جُنُبٍ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَحَرَّمْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْمَراضِعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقالَتْ﴾ his sister: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هَلْ﴾: a particle of interrogation. ﴿أَدُلُّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلى أَهْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿بَيْتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَكْفُلُونَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿ناصِحُونَ﴾: khabar; the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿فَرَدَدْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِلى أُمِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَيْ تَقَرَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by كي. ﴿عَيْنُها﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from كي and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām of causation (taʿlīl) implied before كي, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَلا تَحْزَنَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negative, and تحزن is conjoined to تقر. ﴿وَلِتَعْلَمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after the lām of causation, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar from the implicit أن and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the lām of causation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿أَنَّ وَعْدَ﴾: and أنّ and its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar from أنّ, its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of تعلم. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لكنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿بَلَغَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَشُدَّهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَاسْتَوى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿آتَيْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿حُكْماً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَعِلْماً﴾: conjoined to حكما. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; in كذلك the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive by the kāf, and [both] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَجْزِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وَدَخَلَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمَدِينَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى حِينِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿غَفْلَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of غفلة. ﴿فَوَجَدَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَجُلَيْنِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a dual; the clause is conjoined to دخل. ﴿يَقْتَتِلانِ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the alif is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of رجلين. ﴿هذا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is a second naʿt of رجلين. ﴿وَهذا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿فَاسْتَغاثَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its object. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَوَكَزَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَقَضى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هذا﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ عَمَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الشَّيْطانِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾: its khabar. ﴿مُضِلٌّ مُبِينٌ﴾: two naʿts of عدو; the nominal clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿ظَلَمْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَفْسِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the two clauses, the nominal and the vocative, are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاغْفِرْ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَغَفَرَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾: two khabars; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb of oath. ﴿أَنْعَمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَلَنْ أَكُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, and its noun is latent. ﴿ظَهِيراً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أكون. ﴿لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظهيرا; the clause gives the cause of what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿فَأَصْبَحَ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الْمَدِينَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them. ﴿خائِفاً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَتَرَقَّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَإِذَا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿إذا﴾: [إذا] of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اسْتَنْصَرَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْأَمْسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَغَوِيٌّ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿أَنْ﴾: redundant (zāʾida). ﴿أَرادَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنْ يَبْطِشَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, its fāʿil latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أراد. ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿هُوَ عَدُوٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي. ﴿لَهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عدو. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā). ﴿أَتُرِيدُ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation. ﴿تُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause قال.. is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. And ﴿أَنْ تَقْتُلَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is the object of تريد. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a particle of comparison and genitive, and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿قَتَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِالْأَمْسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَنْ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is إِنْ.]»: negative. ﴿تُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ تَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and its noun is latent. ﴿جَبَّاراً﴾: its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what follows it is the object of تريد. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جبارا. ﴿وَما تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وَجاءَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿جاءَ رَجُلٌ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And ﴿مِنْ أَقْصَى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجل. ﴿الْمَدِينَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَسْعى﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a second naʿt of رجل. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā); the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الْمَلَأَ﴾: its noun. ﴿يَأْتَمِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿بِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿لِيَقْتُلُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يأتمرون. ﴿فَاخْرُجْ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition). ﴿اخرج﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الناصحين. ﴿مِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿فَخَرَجَ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿خرج﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿خائِفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَتَرَقَّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿نَجِّنِي﴾: a verb of supplication and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is also the object of the saying. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمَّا﴾: temporal and conditional. ﴿تَوَجَّهَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تِلْقاءَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position.
﴿عَسى﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ يَهْدِيَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb of supplication, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the khabar (predicate) of عسى. ﴿سَواءَ﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿السَّبِيلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause عسى is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿وَرَدَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ماءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَجَدَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمة. ﴿يَسْقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَوَجَدَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿امْرَأَتَيْنِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَذُودانِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of امرأتين.
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَطْبُكُما﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَتا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾: negative; and ﴿نَسْقِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يُصْدِرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى. ﴿الرِّعاءُ﴾: fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَأَبُونا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns. ﴿شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ﴾: two khabars; the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿فَسَقى﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَوَلَّى﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سقى. ﴿إِلَى الظِّلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قال is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لِما﴾: ما is a relative, genitive by the lām; [both] are attached to فقير. ﴿أَنْزَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَى﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is إِلَيَّ.]»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقِيرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فَجاءَتْهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its object. ﴿إِحْداهُما﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is a dual «[Translator's note: so in the source; إحدى is singular and is nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif; the dual sense belongs to the pronoun هما.]»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿تَمْشِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَى اسْتِحْياءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl. ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause جاءته by an omitted conjunction. ﴿إِنَّ أَبِي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿يَدْعُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لِيَجْزِيَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿سَقَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَقَصَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْقَصَصَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا تَخَفْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿نَجَوْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of القوم.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿قالَتْ إِحْداهُما﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَبَتِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اسْتَأْجِرْهُ﴾: an imperative verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنَّ خَيْرَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿مَنِ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اسْتَأْجَرْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ﴾: two khabars (predicates) of إنّ; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْ أُنْكِحَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِحْدَى﴾: its second object. ﴿ابْنَتَيَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هاتَيْنِ﴾: the hā is for alerting (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is a naʿt (adjective) of ابنتي; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the object of أريد. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ تَأْجُرَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ثَمانِيَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿حِجَجٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَتْمَمْتَ﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its fāʿil. ﴿عَشْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa). ﴿من عندك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْ أَشُقَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is the object of أريد. ﴿سَتَجِدُنِي﴾: the sīn is for the future. ﴿وتجدني﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And ﴿أَنْ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is إِنْ.]»: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ستجدني; and the clause ﴿إِنْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَبَيْنَكَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بيني. ﴿أَيَّمَا﴾: أيّ is a jussive conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قضيت, and ما is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿الْأَجَلَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَضَيْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and لا operates like إنّ. ﴿عُدْوانَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word here is عَلى.]»: a preposition. ﴿ما﴾: a noun genitive by على; both are attached to وكيل. ﴿نَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكِيلٌ﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿قَضى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿مُوسَى﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْأَجَلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَسارَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and سار is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قضى. ﴿بِأَهْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿آنَسَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ جانِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ناراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِأَهْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿امْكُثُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿آنَسْتُ ناراً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿آتِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is likewise causal. ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿بِخَبَرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿جَذْوَةٍ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of جذوة. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿تَصْطَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿أَتاها﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿نُودِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ شاطِئِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْوادِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْأَيْمَنِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of الوادي. ﴿فِي الْبُقْعَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb نودي. ﴿الْمُبارَكَةِ﴾: a naʿt of البقعة. The clause نودي is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ﴾: a badal (substitute) from His words من شاطئ الوادي. ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative (mufassira). ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَنَا﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿رَبُّ﴾: a second khabar. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause أن يا موسى is explicative, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَأَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative (mufassira). ﴿أَلْقِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَصاكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿رَآها﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تَهْتَزُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَأَنَّها﴾: كأنّ and its noun. ﴿جَانٌّ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is likewise a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَّى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مُدْبِراً﴾: ḥāl; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يُعَقِّبْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā). ﴿أَقْبِلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the speech is resumptive. ﴿وَلا تَخَفْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the lā of prohibition, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ﴾: the khabar of إنّ; the clause gives the cause of the command.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿اسْلُكْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿يَدَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي جَيْبِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿تَخْرُجْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْضاءَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ غَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بيضاء. ﴿سُوءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاضْمُمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اسلك. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿جَناحَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الرَّهْبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿فَذانِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بُرْهانانِ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a naʿt of برهانان. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the kāf. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾: conjoined to فرعون. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾: its khabar. ﴿فاسِقِينَ﴾: a naʿt of قوما; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنهم, and the nominal clause gives the cause of the two proofs that were sent.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿قَتَلْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني. The two clauses, the nominal and the vocative, are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَأَخافُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is a mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وَأَخِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هارُونُ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿هُوَ أَفْصَحُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of أخي. ﴿مِنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفصح. ﴿لِساناً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿فَأَرْسِلْهُ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and a verb of supplication and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَعِي﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿رِدْءاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿يُصَدِّقُنِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ردءا. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَخافُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause أخاف is the khabar of إني, the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the object of أخاف, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَنَشُدُّ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَضُدَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِأَخِيكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَنَجْعَلُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿نَجْعَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿يَصِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to يصلون. ﴿أَنْتُما﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَمَنِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَمَنِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿اتَّبَعَكُمَا﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْغالِبُونَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿هذا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿سِحْرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُفْتَرىً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of سحر; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فِي آبائِنَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: a naʿt of آبائنا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وَقالَ مُوسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, genitive by the bāʾ; [both] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of تكون. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾: its postponed noun. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿ها﴾: for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الْمَلَأُ﴾: badal (substitute) from أيها. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿عَلِمْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾: genitive in form and accusative in position, the object of علمت. ﴿غَيْرِي﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of إله; the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَأَوْقِدْ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا هامانُ﴾: the one addressed, a single proper noun (mufrad ʿalam), indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿عَلَى الطِّينِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the vocative clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿فَاجْعَلْ لِي﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فأوقد لي. ﴿صَرْحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿أَطَّلِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى إِلهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَأَظُنُّهُ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿أظنه﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and both are in the place of the second object; the verbal clause is the khabar of إني, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَاسْتَكْبَرَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَكْبَرَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿هُوَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جُنُودُهُ﴾: conjoined to the latent fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ظَنُّوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun; the clause stands in place of the two objects of ظنوا. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجُنُودَهُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the accusative pronoun. ﴿فَنَبَذْناهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْيَمِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾: the postponed noun of كان. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause كيف كان.. stands in place of the two objects of انظر.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿أَئِمَّةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَى النَّارِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of أئمة. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُنْصَرُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وَأَتْبَعْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: badal (substitute) from the demonstrative. ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْمَقْبُوحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and the thing sworn by is omitted. ﴿قد﴾: a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسَى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer to the implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya. ﴿أَهْلَكْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْقُرُونَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأُولى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of القرون; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَصائِرَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصائر. ﴿وَهُدىً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بصائر. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾: also conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿بِجانِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت. ﴿الْغَرْبِيِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿قَضَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى مُوسَى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَمْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَما كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: لكنّ and its noun. ﴿أَنْشَأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قُرُوناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فَتَطاوَلَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْعُمُرُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿ثاوِياً﴾: its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي أَهْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ثاويا. ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَتْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿آياتِنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: لكنّ and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: an incomplete past verb and its noun. ﴿مُرْسِلِينَ﴾: its khabar; the verbal clause is the khabar of لكنّ. The nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿بِجانِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿نادَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), without governing effect (muhmal). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿قَوْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implicit أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted, implied verb. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿أَتاهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿نَذِيرٍ﴾: genitive in form and nominative in position, the fāʿil of أتاهم; the clause is a naʿt of قوما. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿مُصِيبَةٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿فَيَقُولُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يقولوا﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تصيبهم. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أَرْسَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya). ﴿نتبع﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after the fāʾ, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿آياتِكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَنَكُونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb conjoined to نتبع, and its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of نكون.
