daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَهُمُ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِثْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمْ يَكْفُرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أُوتِيَ مُوسى﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿سِحْرانِ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿تَظاهَرا﴾: a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of سحران. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿بِكُلٍّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كافرون. ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾: the khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِكِتابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كتاب. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَهْدى﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is a second naʿt of كتاب. ﴿مِنْهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أهدى. ﴿أَتَّبِعْهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the conditional particle here is إِنْ.]»: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَاعْلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنَّما﴾: [أنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause أنما يتبعون.. is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in place of the two objects of اعلم. The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَضَلُّ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أضل. ﴿اتَّبَعَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿هَواهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُدىً﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by من, and both are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of هدى. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْقَوْمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt of القوم; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in ayah 43. ﴿وَصَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْقَوْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the answer to the implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.
The verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم, and the nominal clause الذين.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿يُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the answer of إذا, with no grammatical position. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّنا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إِنَّا﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿مُسْلِمِينَ﴾: the khabar of كنا; the clause كنا.. is the khabar of إنا, and the clause إنا.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُؤْتَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَجْرَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for the absolute object). ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يؤتون. ﴿وَيَدْرَؤُنَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿السَّيِّئَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ينفقون. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause يؤتون, so it is in the position of nominative like it.

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿سَمِعُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّغْوَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَعْرَضُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer of إذا, with no grammatical position. And the clause إذا.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَعْمالُنا﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَكُمْ أَعْمالُكُمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the nominal clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿نَبْتَغِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْجاهِلِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:56-56.t:
﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَنْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنك, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَحْبَبْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent.
The clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar. ﴿بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:57-57.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَتَّبِعِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْهُدى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿نُتَخَطَّفْ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and إن and what follows it are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿نُمَكِّنْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by لم, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿حَرَماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمِناً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of حرما; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُجْبى﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ثَمَراتُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿كُلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a second naʿt of حرما. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رزقا. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: the noun of لكنّ. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وَكَمْ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿كَمْ﴾: predicative (khabariyya), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, the tamyīz (specification) of كم; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَطِرَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَعِيشَتَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قرية. ﴿فَتِلْكَ مَساكِنُهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لَمْ تُسْكَنْ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْوارِثِينَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: its noun. ﴿مُهْلِكَ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَبْعَثَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implicit أن and what follows it is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) مهلك. ﴿فِي أُمِّها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَتْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿آياتِنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of رسولا. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿مُهْلِكِي﴾: its khabar. ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿أَهْلُها ظالِمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وَما﴾: ما is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُوتِيتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَمَتاعُ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: naʿt (adjective); the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما. ﴿وَزِينَتُها﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to متاع. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾: conjoined to خير. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). The verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿مِنَ﴾ «[Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word is the relative مَنْ.]»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَعَدْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَعْداً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of وعدا. ﴿فَهُوَ لاقِيهِ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿كَمَنْ﴾: من is relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿مَتَّعْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila of من. ﴿مَتاعَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: naʿt. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر يوم" (remember the day). ﴿يُنادِيهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿أَيْنَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿شُرَكائِيَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of شركائي. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿تَزْعُمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The two objects of تزعمون are omitted because what precedes them indicates them.

daas-irab:63-63.t: ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَقَّ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْقَوْلُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿أَغْوَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَغْوَيْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هؤلاء. ﴿كَما﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿غَوَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ثم﴾: conjunctive. ﴿تَبَرَّأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿إِيَّانا﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَعْبُدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause ما كانوا.. is a second ḥāl.

daas-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وَقِيلَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿ادْعُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿شُرَكاءَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَدَعَوْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فَلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.
﴿وَرَأَوُا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رأوا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كانوا.. is the khabar of أنّ. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أنّ, its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb.

daas-irab:65-65.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يوم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, اذكر (remember). ﴿يُنادِيهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَجَبْتُمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:66-66.t: ﴿فَعَمِيَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; عميت is a passive past verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; عَمِيَتْ is in the active voice, and الأنباء is its fāʿil (agent).]», and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَنْباءُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time annexed to its like. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَتَساءَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:67-67.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿أما﴾: a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تابَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَآمَنَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تاب. ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾: also conjoined. ﴿صالِحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَعَسى﴾: the fāʾ falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عسى﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle that puts in the accusative. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is the khabar of عسى, the clause عسى.. is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من, and the clause أما من.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَيَخْتارُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يخلق. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿الْخِيَرَةُ﴾: its postponed noun; the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَعالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يُعْلِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿وَهُوَ اللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation, operating like إنّ. ﴿إِلهَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾: badal (substitute) from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar of لا; the nominal clause is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a fronted khabar. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو. ﴿فِي الْأُولى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) الحمد. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الأولى. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a fronted khabar. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to what follows them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَرْمَداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جعل. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَنْ إِلهٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of إله. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَأْتِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِضِياءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is a naʿt of إله. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لا is negative. ﴿تَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
